[[Galduran Calrissian]], a smuggler who was forced to sell all of his belongings by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], once owned an '''utility belt'''. The belt found its way to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] where it was available for purchase from merchants at the [[Jedi Enclave]].

==Behind the scenes==
The item would give the characters wearing a bonus to their Computer Use and Repair skills as well as their Demolitions and Security skills if they were trained in them.
